title: Follicular Recoverability Knee is an actuator-conditional response-gain transition, not a static baldness threshold

definition.baseline_burden: z = prospectively declared degeneration/structural-state coordinate measured before intervention
definition.actuator: u = one prospectively declared intervention and dose/context
definition.local_control_gain: g(z,u) = partial functional recovery / partial declared control input for that actuator
definition.operational_knee: FRK(u) candidate = a reproducible region where g(z,u) loses gain unusually steeply under a predeclared contrast/model-comparison rule

known_answers.reason: uniform linear gain loss has no unique knee under the frozen definition

required_evidence: baseline burden measured before the control input
one declared actuator/dose/context per response surface rather than pooling mechanistically different controls
reference comparison sufficient to estimate intervention response gain
functional later output linked to the prediction unit
coverage across enough baseline-burden range to estimate gain change
donor/region hierarchy and attrition handled under HF-SIM-038/HF-SIM-039
observer and diagnostic-probe back-action controlled where applicable
HF-SIM-041 pseudo-knee/noise attack passed with predeclared contrast or explicit no-knee-vs-knee model comparison
transition region replicated outside the data used to choose it
human_conflict_context: HF01_HUMAN_MINIATURIZATION_RESPONSE_LEDGER_V1 documents that finasteride biopsy-count, finasteride mapped-hair, and sublingual-minoxidil hair-to-hair studies yield different apparent reversal/response patterns under different measurement units, doses and actuators. This blocks a universal miniaturization threshold.
stage_marker_boundary: Cross-sectional partial-bald vs complete-bald differences in CD34/Sox9 or structure may define useful sampling strata but do not themselves identify FRK(u) because no intervention-response gain is measured.
non_equivalences: progenitor loss threshold != FRK(u) without response data
one actuator's gain knee != universal treatment threshold
ex-vivo FRK != in-vivo clinical decision rule
next_test: After HF-VAL-006 establishes linked early-state/later-function prediction, estimate actuator-specific response surfaces over prospectively measured baseline P/E/M burden and compare smooth/no-knee models against predeclared transition models under donor-held-out validation.
claim_boundary: FRK(u) is currently an operational research target only. No universal or human in-vivo recoverability knee has been demonstrated.
